result.final_text:
## What this letter says

Your blood test on 29 September 2026 showed a result of 52 mmol/mol.

A result of 48 mmol/mol or above may mean type 2 diabetes (a condition where your body has trouble managing blood sugar).

Because you do not have any symptoms right now, the doctor needs another blood test to be sure.

The doctor has not made a diagnosis yet.

## What you need to do

1. Book a repeat blood test with the practice nurse within the next 2 weeks.
2. After this test, book an appointment with Dr Thompson to discuss the result.
3. Do not start any new medicine for diabetes before you have spoken to the doctor.

Note: You do not need to fast (stop eating) before this test.

## Dates and medicines

- Blood test: 29 September 2026 - result was 52 mmol/mol
- No medicines listed in this letter.

## Questions to ask your doctor

1. What does my HbA1c result mean exactly?
2. When will I get the result of my second blood test?
3. What happens if the second test shows a result of 48 mmol/mol or above?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
